comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
in trying to figure out the cause of another error I noticed that the CI appears to [fail](https://github.com/dask/dask/actions/runs/5815892235/job/15768167845) on a internal error ever since Aug 9 (the last "successful" [CI run](https://github.com/dask/dask/actions/runs/5803814557/job/15732467736)).

I'm not sure if `pytest` emits a log for this (if you can write a reproducing test without `dask` I'll check if I can make the internal error visible in the report), but it does mean that a lot of tests never run.

(Edit: also, the `xarray`-related test failures are caused by the import, which should be fixed but not released)

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
in `numpy>=2.0`, `numpy.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view` has become an alias of `numpy.lib._stride_tricks_impl.sliding_window_view` (and the functions in `numpy.lib.two_dim` have been moved to the top level), so the idea of following the module structure in the [`__array_function__` implementation](https://github.com/dask/dask/blob/216c7c9393d8df1014a911eceb797502999e8a51/dask/array/core.py#L1742-L1746) is currently broken.

As far as I can tell, you have (at least) two options: exactly follow the `numpy` package structure, or check immediately whether the function is in `HANDLED_FUNCTION` and only try to auto-generate a implementation / fall back to the in-memory version if that is not the case.

(we're seeing this in our [upstream-dev tests](https://github.com/pydata/xarray/issues/8091) for rolling operations)
